notes:
Account background: mid-market analytics SaaS (customer success + insights product). Product team building an agentic assistant that chains search -> plan -> action (open tickets, push metadata). Evaluating Hosted API first for speed of shipping, then Dedicated if we need predictable throughput and lower tail latency.

POC details / technical asks:
- Workload: multi-turn agentic chat (avg session 4-7 tool calls), high concurrency during business hours (~200-400 concurrent agents in prod target).
- Latency SLO: interactive streaming goal = p50 <80ms, p95 <400ms token latency; overall turn time <2s for simple queries.
- Tool-calls: heavy reliance on internal search + ticketing API. Need reliable function-calls with clear retry/backoff semantics and idempotency. "Agent must not hang on tool call" — quote from Head of Product.
- Streaming: want chunked streaming + partial tool outputs, ability to attach/encode function call args in stream. Observability hooks needed for per-call timings and trace correlation to customer search logs.
- Failover needs: prefer automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper model variant when Dedicated capacity saturated; also region-aware routing.

Risk notes & asks to Redwood:
- During POC saw 2-3% tool-call failures correlated with upstream search latency spikes; product team wants guidance on best practice (server-side timeouts vs SDK level, circuit breaker).
- Need a recommended pattern for session affinity / KV cache to avoid re-warming KV across tool-call chains.
- Pricing: ask for committed concurrency SKU (monthly) vs pure per-token; want clear example math for our expected patterns (multi-step calls amplify token cost).

Commercial / process:
- Decision driver: reliability of multi-step tool chains + predictable tail latency + price predictability.
- Legal: requesting DPA + data residency confirmation for NA EU overlap customers.
- Next engagement: run 2-week production-like POC (SE to provision), include synthetic spike tests and long-tail monitoring.
